title: Form Facet
description: Accreted binding facet for form/template source, sibling to the procedure facet. Single-writer: the headwater authoring agent (form-specialized). Models a form TEMPLATE (a blank instrument) — never a submission. A filled-in form is an instance with real data (potential PII); it is a record/learner-model object under separate governance and is NOT modeled here. The action/label text lives in meaning.source_text; structure (sections, order) lives in the object facet; provenance lives in governance. This facet holds only what is irreducibly about capturing structured input. field_type and content_disposition are MIRRORS of vocab/form.enum.json (vocab wins; a conformance check asserts schema enum == vocab ids). performed_by reuses roles.registry and captures_record reuses records.registry — the SAME registries the procedure facet uses; no form-specific copy. v0.2 adds constraints.slots: NAMED fill-in points inside otherwise-retained text, so an instance overlay can key on (atom_id, slot_id) instead of a position in a string.

field_type.description: Governed input primitive. Present on form_field leaves; omitted on form/form_section containers. MIRROR of vocab/form.enum.json field_type ids.

content_disposition.description: Authoring lifecycle of this field's standard/source text, from the form template's own rules. MIRROR of vocab/form.enum.json content_disposition ids.

constraints.description: Validation/integrity rules on the accepted value. Embedded (they ARE part of the field's invariant truth), not a reference.

slots.description: Named fill-in points inside this field's source_text — the [bracketed] spans a template leaves for the author inside text that is otherwise retained unchanged. A field like this has genuinely MIXED disposition: the sentence is controlled_standard, the slots are authorable. The facet carries one disposition per field, so the slots are declared here instead. NAMED, never positional: an instance overlay keys on (atom_id, slot_id), and a positional reference ('slot 2') would shift the moment anyone edits the sentence — exactly what stable ids exist to prevent. No field_type here on purpose: repeating that closed list would spawn a drifting second copy.

id.description: Stable name, unique within this field. Half of the (atom_id, slot_id) key.

expects.description: What the author must supply here, in plain words.

options_ref.description: Controlled value set, when the slot takes one. A pattern, not an enum — no closed list is copied here.
Registry id of the controlled value set for select_one/select_many. Reference the option set; never embed it.

captures_record.description: records.registry id (rec_...) this field/form populates — the GxP evidence link. SAME registry as procedure.produces_records.

performed_by.description: roles.registry ids (role_...) accountable to complete/sign this field. Roles, never people (no PII). SAME registry as procedure.performed_by.

conditional_on.description: Show/require logic: this field applies only when the referenced field-atom holds the given value. Mirrors procedure.branches at the field level.
